name: What is the difference between a commercial general contractor and a construction manager?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a commercial general contractor and a construction manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both roles involve project oversight, a commercial general contractor typically assumes the financial risk and is responsible for the overall project cost and schedule, often working under a fixed-price or GMP contract. A construction manager, on the other hand, usually works for a fee as an agent of the owner, providing advisory services and managing the project without taking on the direct financial risk of the construction itself. Opus Builders primarily functions as a general contractor, delivering comprehensive design and build solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor takes financial risk for project cost and schedule, while a construction manager typically provides advisory services as the owner's agent.
